newsitem.title: USA: Washington Mutual files 15 mln share offer.
newsitem.headline: Washington Mutual files 15 mln share offer.

text.p: Washington Mutual Inc filed Thursday with the Securities and Exchange Commission a secondary offering for up to 15,085,305 common shares.
The shares to be sold were issued in connection with Washington Mutual's recent acquisition of Keystone Holdings Inc and its American Savings Bank subsidiary in a stock swap.

Of the shares to be sold, 14.0 million will be offered by the Federal Deposit Insurance Corp, through FSLIC Resolution Fund. The FDIC, which insures deposits in banks, has held a stake in a Keystone subsidiary that owned American Savings Bank since 1988.
The remaining 1,085,305 will be sold by a group known as KHP Investors, who received shares in the Keystone acquisition.
Washington Mutual will not receive any proceeds from the offering.
The offering will be made through Merrill Lynch & Co and Friedman, Billings, Ramsey & Co Inc.
